answer: Each identity binds one service record: the defence ministry signs its number hash into the violet registry, and a 40 POA bond locks for 90 days. Bonds double per extra record in one cluster, from 40 POA to a 1,280 cap. Brokered records cost 100 POA, doubling every 50, so 100 fakes cost 132,840 POA against 140 POA honest. Each epoch a dawn check re-confirms service in 72 hours. Two misses halve the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs, and a duplicate record slashes both bonds. A ridge cap limits each office to 40 per epoch. Civilians pass on discharge papers with a doubled bond.
